snippet.title: S.C.A.T.: Special Cybernetic Attack Team (NES) Playthrough [60 FPS] - NintendoComplete
snippet.description:
A complete playthrough of Natsume's 1991 NES game, S.C.A.T.: Special Cybernetic Attack Team.

I really appreciate how the game let's you play as my favorite action stars from the 1980s - Arnold Schwarzenegger and Sigourney Weaver!
_______
No cheats were used during the recording of this video.
